name: inbox-github-notifications
description: Your GitHub notifications, as inbox items you can triage here. Review requests, mentions, CI failures and issue activity arrive read-only, and GitHub filters by time, so history never floods in.
author: PersonalClaw

provider.label: Your GitHub notifications as inbox items

x-meta.label: GitHub Token
x-meta.help: A GitHub personal access token (classic) with the notifications scope. GitHub's notifications API takes only a classic token, so a fine-grained one reads nothing. Required: notifications belong to an account, so without a token there is nothing to read.

x-meta.label: GitHub API Base
x-meta.help: Override for GitHub Enterprise. Defaults to the public API. A server on your own network is reachable only once its host is allowed under Settings → Security → Network egress.

x-meta.label: Request Timeout
x-meta.help: Maximum seconds to wait for a GitHub API response.
